name: Lydi
source:
An elf woman dwelling deep within the Croft Forest. She detests humans, including Matthias.

Though serious and obstinate in nature, she's very kind to those she trusts.

She appears to be around 20 years old, but her actual age is 320. 

She's very skilled with her hands, and her specialty is making accessories.

[Translated from [url=https://game-creators.camp/games/36536704/utueru]official profile[/url]]
